name: Cardholder Experience
description: Move the cardholder-facing products off the servicing monolith and onto the Azure product shape one at a time, rewards first, so each is a shape and a handful of answers rather than a build.

name: Consumer Lending Growth
description: Take the card business into installment lending, on the cloud landing zone rather than the on-premises estate, and prove the landing zone can carry a regulated product before anything else is asked to move onto it.

name: Merchant Self-Service
description: Give merchants a channel of their own: sign-up, settlement and chargeback visibility, and statements, without a call to the acquiring desk. The first program assembled from the library's parts rather than built on a shape, because no merchant-facing shape existed yet; if a second merchant product follows, its parts become one.

name: Regulatory Reporting Readiness
description: Replace the spreadsheet-based regulatory return and the manual sanctions check with systems the estate can evidence, ahead of the reporting obligations that fall due through 2027 and 2028.
